description: The engine's bundled skills a new bot keeps switched on (B38, ADR-0047). Every other bundled skill (the engine's own list, `skills/.bundled_manifest` in the bot's home) goes into the bot's `skills.disabled` when boopis makes the bot, and once for the bots of an install made before this list. A skill the bot got any other way (the store, a team file, one it wrote, boopis's own `boopis-handoffs`) is never touched. Widen one bot with its skill switches in the app, `skills:` in a team file, or the engine's `skills enable`; widen every new bot by adding a name here. The owner chooses what is in this list.

on.name: hermes-agent
on.why: The engine's own manual; the engine never lets it be switched off and its prompt points at it.

on.name: sdlc-review
on.why: The kanban review lane loads it into every review worker; a switched-off skill is not loaded, so review cards would run without it.

on.name: grounded-citations
on.why: Research and fact-checks with sources (the Paper Past team: nina's research, kai's fact-check; 'real, sourced facts only').

on.name: blocked-page-recovery
on.why: What to do when fetching a source fails (403, 429, a paywall): the researchers fetch every source they cite.
